reason: The hypothesis combines the serrated grain boundary mechanism for creep improvement (P2, P5) with Mo-induced corrosion resistance and strength enhancement (P9, P13, P15, P16) into a single intervention for room-temperature properties, which no single passage proposes. It also applies the high-temperature creep benefit of serrated boundaries to room-temperature creep, a transfer not made in the cited passages. However, the individual components (Mo for strength/corrosion, serrated boundaries for creep) are directly taken from the literature, and the combination is a straightforward additive synthesis without a novel mechanistic link or resolution of a conflict.
